title: Deion Sanders is disappointed he didn't hear from the Jaguars about Travis Hunter

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deion Sanders is disappointed he didn't hear from the Jaguars about Travis Hunter
sources.description: When Colorado coach Deion Sanders recently explained his desire to meet with new Browns coach Todd Monken as a coach and not a father, Deion pointed out that, in 2025, he got no questions from the Browns about coaching Shedeur Sanders.
